scope: Proposition 3.10 (Uniform exterior geometry) of the manuscript “Bounded scalar curvature and smooth extension of four-dimensional Ricci flow” (preprints/Bounded-scalar-curvature-and-smooth-extension-of-four-dimensional-Ricci-flow-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 351 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 95655c4053c94f2b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 25. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix a sufficiently high finite derivative order kgeo and numbers 0 < µ < σ < 1. There are fixed constants Ngeom, C, cgeom > 0 and outer radii Rout i → ∞ in interval units, with ϵiRout i → 0, with the following property. At every time in the buffered interval the exterior region admits one equivariant coordinate system whose annuli satisfy r2 | Rm |kgeo,r + |g − δ|kgeo,r ≤ CΘi(r), Θi(r) = (ai/r)µ + δirµ , δi = (Rout i )−µ −→ 0 (3.27) for Ngeomai ≤ r ≤ cgeomRout i . The charts cover whole shortened distance bands with boundary margins; their nontrivial quotient group is fixed after subsequence extraction. Moreover ϵi = o(δi). The constant C is uniform in time and radius and is unchanged when the lower bound is restricted to Nai for any larger fixed N.
